attchmntText: Senco Gold Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication dated 15th November,2026
voiceSummary: Senco Gold Limited has filed an intimation regarding the publication of its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during a meeting held on 13th November 2026. The company published the financial results in the Financial Express and Dainik Statesman newspapers on 15th November 2026. The results are also available on the company website. This filing is made pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The notice was signed by Mukund Chandak, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Senco Gold Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Press Release for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026".
voiceSummary: Senco Gold Limited filed a press release regarding its financial performance for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of Rs 5,114.8 crore for H1 FY27, representing 52% year-on-year growth. Profit after tax reached Rs 187.8 crore for H1, a 22% increase. The firm added 14 new showrooms, bringing its total retail network to 215 locations. Trailing twelve-month sales crossed Rs 10,000 crore. The company plans to launch 6 to 7 additional showrooms in H2 FY27. Gold prices ranged between Rs 1,40,000 and Rs 1,50,000 per 10 grams. Inventory increased to Rs 5,487.8 crore, and borrowings rose to Rs 2,612.7 crore. The company targets over 25% growth in H2 FY27.

attchmntText: Senco Gold Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Senco Gold Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on 13th November 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of Rs 5,115 Cr and EBITDA of Rs 391 Cr for H1 FY27. The stud ratio stood at 11.6%. The company operates 215 showrooms, comprising 123 company-owned and 92 franchisee outlets. Expansion targets for FY30 include 300+ showrooms and Rs 20,000 Cr revenue. The presentation is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Senco Gold Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Senco Gold Limited has approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting held on 13 November 2026. The Limited Review Reports were issued by statutory auditor Walker Chandiok & Co LLP. For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, the company reported revenue from operations of 20,587.28 million and a profit after tax of 866.68 million. For the six-month period ended 30 September 2026, revenue from operations was 33,623.91 million with a profit after tax of 1,878.11 million. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee. The company's CIN is U13691WB1994PLC064637. The NSE symbol is SENCO.
